Self-review: session changes 2025-06-15 (eb544a26..HEAD).

Review confidence: 10% chance of missed bug.
Least confident areas: pkix-revocation/src/crl.rs Cow-based find_matching_entry refactor (correctness of Name lifetime threading through indirect CRL entry iteration), and the general_name_matches PartialEq delegation (correctness depends on upstream x509-cert PartialEq semantics matching the previous DER-byte-equality for all non-DN variants).
Would raise confidence if: ran the full PKITS and x509-limbo test suite; reviewed the upstream x509-cert GeneralName PartialEq implementation.

Second-pass review (independent reviewer) confirmed all findings. No additional correctness bugs found. The PartialEq delegation was independently verified against x509-cert 0.2.5's GeneralName definition which derives Eq+PartialEq — semantically equivalent to DER comparison for non-DN variants.
